title: Python Beginner Mock Test 2
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for Python at beginner level.

questions.prompt: A learner needs to apply assignment. Which choice is the most reliable approach?

options.text: use `total = price * quantity` when the computed value is needed later
using a name before assignment raises NameError
Suppress every error and continue
Replace the operation with an unrelated print statement

questions.explanation: use `total = price * quantity` when the computed value is needed later. This matters because Python follows explicit runtime rules; verify the behavior with a minimal example rather than guessing.
questions.recommendedLessonTitle: Running Python and Working with Values
